statement: The Windows networking runtime build fixture initializes the platform directory, installs the outer CXX compiler metadata and enables CXX without repeating compiler or binutils discovery. The outer binary-inspection tools are forwarded. Compiler-free regressions check effective registration with its 90-second timeout, tool forwarding, initialized language rules and missing or incomplete metadata refusals. The real DLL compilation, staging, import scanning, execution, deletion repair without relinking and Debug/Release isolation checks remain. UCRT64 configure/build timings and 20 consecutive runs well below 15 seconds remain pending.
